title: C-78: character select shows the AFK disconnect
notes: The run seeds one wizard so sign-in reaches character select instead of the new-account creation flow.
Three no-input settling captures give the client time to finish loading character select; the last records the wizard before the AFK timeout.
The client log must identify GUI_ConnectionAFK, and the rendered message is captured for visual review.
server_log_allowed: character_create_school holds no school, so no wizard can be created until it does
realmlist holds no realm, so no player can be sent to a gameserver until one is added

steps.name: the client brings its renderer up
the login window is on the screen
the client sends its authentication request
the client is admitted
steps.pattern: The LoginServer has admitted the user

steps.name: the login server lists the seeded wizard
the character selection scene loads
steps.pattern: WizardCharacterSelect: The scene has been loaded successfully\.

steps.name: the character selection scene is still loading
the character selection scene continues loading
the selected wizard on character select before the idle timeout
the server sends the AFK disconnect after the timeout
steps.pattern: Session \d+ from \S+ was idle for \d+ s, reaching Login\.AfkTimeout of 150 s; sent MSG_DISCONNECT_LOGIN_AFK Warning=(-?\d+) and closed the session

steps.name: the client chooses its AFK disconnect message
the client does not report a generic lost connection
